hints.title: Prime Divisor Precomputation
hints.text: Determine the unique prime divisors present in each element before analyzing split boundaries.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Accumulation
hints.text: Accumulate distinct prime factors in a leftward prefix pass and a rightward suffix pass.

hints.title: Boundary Evaluation
hints.text: For each valid split position, sum the prefix unique prime count and the suffix unique prime count to find the optimal result.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.time: O(M log log M + N * P)
variables: P: maximum distinct prime factors per element
complexity.notes: Precomputing smallest prime factors allows fast factor extraction followed by linear prefix and suffix accumulations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Factoring and reconstructing prime sets from scratch for every split index causes quadratic overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing prefix and suffix set sizes avoids repeated set unions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that prefix and suffix prime collections can be precomputed independently.
